item_text: how the pinned HallThruster.jl v0.23.1 (bfb3019f) represents the cathode / coupling potential (read from the pinned source)
gate: NP-ICP prereg v1 verify_gate (inherited by v2): a verification addendum records the source read (locator, access, sha256 where lawful) and confirms the text

source.access: anonymous git fetch of the pinned commit (depth 1) through the session's git proxy, 2026-10-07; read only, nothing executed

read.coupling_potential: The cathode is not modelled as a device: it is the right (downstream) boundary of the 1-D domain. Its potential is the configuration input `cathode_coupling_voltage` [V] ('The potential at the right boundary of the simulation. **Default:** `0`', configuration.jl 76-78; default 0.0 at 213; converted to volts at 351; passed to the parameters at 480).
read.where_it_enters: electron_update.jl 85-89: V_L = Vd[] + Vs[] (discharge voltage plus the anode sheath potential) and V_R = params.cathode_coupling_voltage; the discharge current is I = (Delta V + int1) / int2 with Delta V = V_L - V_R (lines 161-162). The potential profile is integrated from V_L at the left edge (potential.jl 33-34: cumtrapz!(phi, ..., V_L)), so the right-boundary potential enters through the current that the momentum-integral closure returns.
read.electron_temperature: The electron temperature at the same boundary is a Dirichlet value Te_R = `cathode_Tev` (default 2.0 eV; configuration.jl 86-90, 215, 471; electron_energy.jl 151-154: 0.5 (n_eps[end-1]/n_e[end-1] + n_eps[end]/n_e[end]) = 3/2 Te_R).
read.not_present: No cathode emission current, no coupling-voltage solve and no neutralizer model: the coupling potential is an input of the Hall run, never an output.

confirmation: VER-23 is answered as CPL-HON-05 asks: the pinned HallThruster.jl takes the coupling potential as the scalar input `cathode_coupling_voltage` [V] (right-boundary potential, with the right-boundary electron temperature `cathode_Tev` a separate input). A Hall <-> ICP fixed point therefore sets V_coupling as that input of each Hall run (or as a map axis). VER-23 is CLEARED.
consequence: CPL-HALL-ON-v1 no longer carries VER-23_HALL_COUPLING_POTENTIAL_INPUT_UNVERIFIED (abep-icp v2 cpl.rs).
